title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values in a regression model. Think about how these differences relate to the design matrix.

title: Orthogonality in OLS
text: In the context of OLS regression, orthogonality refers to the residuals being perpendicular to certain vectors. Consider what vectors in the model might have this relationship with the residuals.

hintAnswer: They are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix (X).
title: Exploring Orthogonality
text: Which of the following statements about residuals in OLS regression is true?
choices: They are orthogonal to the column space of the design matrix (X).
Their sum is equal to the mean squared error.
Their sum is equal to zero.
They are orthogonal to the vector of predictions (hat{Y}).
